採用・広告の製品.quote: Most ovulation tests predict your fertile days by tracking Luteinizing Hormone (LH), but fail to measure the hormone that actually confirms your ovulation:
PdG (urine metabolite of progesterone)
, the urine metabolite of progesterone, which rises only after ovulation. That means you don't rely on prediction alone. You see whether ovulation actually happened – or didn't – in your cycle.
PdG - urine metabolite of progesterone

If ovulation occurs, the levels of Progesterone and its urine metabolite PdG rise after a few days and stay elevated. Sustained, elevated PdG levels after peak fertility indicate a successful ovulation.
Pinpoint your right days to try, even with unpredictable cycles
The most precise hormone readings at home
Powered by Inito Spectral Mapping™ Technology, Inito delivers the most precise fertility hormone readings, outperforming other at-home tests in head-to-head lab testing.

Most monitors test multiple hormones on one track, where one hormone can interfere with another and make results less accurate. Inito measures hormones in four independent tracks, so every reading stays precise.
Every hormone shift, precisely measured.
